svg.text: The piece funnels from one thesis through three parallel historical case studies of workless or near-workless
societies, which converge on a single conclusion about what work actually supplies.

g.text: After Work, We'll Have Each Other
Three case studies of relational societies (aristocrats, idle-rich women, working-class peer groups) all converge on
the same finding: work's real value is impersonal respect, not relationships.
